download.title: Download and Install MediaClaw
download.description: MediaClaw is your powerful assistant for social media data operations. Install the extension first, then claim or enter an activation code and follow the tutorial for your first collection. If you do not have a code yet, claim the channel feedback trial.

package_items.title: Download CRX Package
package_items.description: For users who need to manage plugin versions manually

download.steps_title: How to manually install offline package?

steps.title: Download Package
steps.description: Click the button above to download the Chrome extension package in .crx format.

steps.title: Open Extensions
steps.description: Type **chrome://extensions** or **edge://extensions** in the browser address bar and press Enter.

steps.title: Enable Developer Mode
steps.description: In the top right of the extensions page, find and turn on the Developer Mode switch.

steps.title: Drag to Install
steps.description: **Drag and drop** the downloaded .crx file onto the extensions management page to complete the installation.

download_faq.question: Why does Chrome say 'Apps, extensions, and user scripts cannot be added from this website'?
download_faq.answer: This is due to browser security restrictions. Please install via the official Web Store or download the CRX package and follow the 'Offline Installation' steps to drag and drop for installation.

download_faq.question: How to update after offline installation?
download_faq.answer: Offline installed plugins cannot update automatically. When a new version is released, you need to re-download the latest package and repeat the installation steps.

download_faq.question: What if it says 'Package is invalid' during installation?
download_faq.answer: The file might be corrupted during download. Please try downloading it again. If the error persists, check if your browser version is too low.

download.security_description: All installation packages are security-scanned and free of malicious code. We recommend installing via the official Chrome Web Store or Microsoft Edge Add-ons for automatic updates.
